keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.body: A search people type into Google, like "dentist in Riyadh". We check where your website appears for it.

aiPrompt.title: AI question
aiPrompt.body: A question a customer might ask ChatGPT, Gemini or another AI assistant. We check whether the answer mentions or links to you.

competitor.title: Competitor
competitor.body: A website that competes with you for the same customers. We compare your pages with theirs to find what's missing.

verification.title: Ownership verification
verification.body: Proof that you control the website. We need it before we apply any change.

seoScore.title: SEO visibility score
seoScore.body: A 0–100 score of how visible you are in Google for your tracked keywords. Higher positions count more.

shareOfVoice.title: AI share of voice
shareOfVoice.body: Out of all the times AI assistants mention you or your competitors, the share that mentions you.
